title: Warranty Coverage Transfer Fee Proration by Remaining Transferable Term
content:
**Clause.** For a Warranty Coverage transfer, the months of transferable product coverage remaining are the plan's transferred product term in months less the whole months elapsed from the original coverage start date to the confirmation date, a month being complete once the day of the month of the original coverage start date is reached and, in a month that lacks that day, on the last day of that month. When none remain, nothing is left to pass to the buyer and the remaining-term share is zero; when fewer than the proration horizon of **24 months** remain, the fee is prorated and the remaining-term share is the months remaining divided by 24; when at least 24 months remain, the fee is not prorated.

The plan's transferred product term is the cap on every product term for a later owner in the plan's transfer schedule, in years; in months it is that number of years times twelve.

## Months remaining and share

| Months remaining | Remaining-term share |
|---|---|
| zero or fewer | zero — no fee |
| 1 to 23 | months remaining divided by 24 |
| 24 or more | no proration |

## Worked cases (hypothetical transferred product term of 10 years, that is 120 months; original coverage start 1 March 2031)

| Confirmation date | Whole months elapsed | Months remaining | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2037 | 72 | 48 | no proration |
| 1 March 2039 | 96 | 24 | no proration |
| 1 September 2039 | 102 | 18 | 18 divided by 24, that is 0.75 |
| 1 March 2041 | 120 | 0 | zero |

## Completing a month in a shorter month (hypothetical original coverage start 31 January 2031)

| Confirmation date | Whole months elapsed | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 29 April 2031 | 2 | April's last day not yet reached |
| 30 April 2031 | 3 | April lacks a 31st, so the month completes on 30 April |
| 31 May 2031 | 4 | the 31st is reached |
